caption: Albert I (1875–1934), King of the Belgians and commander of the Belgian army, who refused the German ultimatum and held Liège, Antwerp and finally the Yser. Photographed in 1917 in the post-1915 khaki uniform and Adrian helmet. Colorized (AI-assisted) from a public-domain photograph.
credit: Original photograph: Richard Neville Speaight, 1917, The World's Work 1919; public domain (via Wikimedia Commons). Colorization: Sandtable, AI-assisted, 2026.
notes: Provided by Dave 2026-08-22. ANACHRONISM NOTE for the uniforms & kit feature: in August 1914 the Belgian army still wore the dark-blue uniform and shako/bonnet de police; the khaki and Adrian helmet shown date from 1915. Good for the Person card; caption it honestly if shown beside 1914 beats.
